english.legislation: Contrary to section 56 of the London Hackney Carriage Act 1831.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the proprietor,driver or person having the care of a hackney carriage
by intoxication, wanton and furious driving or wilful misconduct
injured or endangered a person in his life, limbs or property
